claim_scope: static numerical contract plus one-record train-only exterior-CPML teacher replay; not a model or checkpoint promotion
hypothesis: The registered 20-layer saved-grid CFS-CPML is wholly outside the 201x201 physical domain on the left, right, and bottom, while the top is a pressure-release free surface. A 221x241 exterior-domain contract can reproduce the fine-grid CPML profiles under factor-two nodal sampling, capture finite causal ADE states, and replay the selected train record's stored physical pressure without opening validation or test_id.
single_conceptual_change: replace the legacy in-physical-domain CPML margin assumption with an explicit three-sided exterior CPML domain contract

pilot_record.selection_reason: high-frequency, high-speed source near the left physical boundary gives early nonzero CPML activity while allowing exact reconstruction of the fine uniform velocity

failure_signal: Any geometry/profile mismatch, non-finite exterior state, nonzero top or outer pressure after hard projection, zero late ADE memory, train replay error above 1e-4, or any validation/test_id access rejects E0 and blocks E1.
rollback: Preserve all existing checkpoints and artifacts. New APIs are optional and default-off for historical solver calls; legacy nonzero cpml_margin remains available only for exact replay of old DG artifacts. Delete or overwrite nothing on failure.
